# Redefines a vanilla key from a differently-named file: last wins.
basic_init_01 = {
	class = sc_ember
	usage = misc_system_init
	flags = { modded }
}

mod_one_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = origin
}

empire_capital_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = empire_init
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = fixture_empire } } }
				create_fixture_empire = yes
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fixture_empire }
				save_global_event_target_as = fixture_empire
			}
			set_owner = event_target:fixture_empire
			generate_owner_pops = yes
			set_star_flag = fixture_beacon
		}
	}
}

empire_colony_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			set_owner = event_target:fixture_empire
		}
	}
}

# The planet gives the system to one empire and the starbase to another.
contested_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			set_owner = event_target:fixture_empire
			create_starbase = {
				size = starbase_hut
				owner = event_target:fixture_fallen
			}
		}
	}
}

scoped_owner_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			set_owner = prev
		}
	}
}

# The moon is a colony outright; nothing else here owns anything.
colony_only_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
	}
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = pc_gas_giant
		moon = {
			count = 1
			class = pc_barren
			init_effect = {
				create_colony = {
					owner = event_target:fixture_empire
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# The day-one sweep: a system only the game-start event can claim, the one
# that seeds the flags it judges by, one already walled off by a starbase,
# and one the event hands to a scope.
sweep_flagged_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { fixture_claimed fixture_map }
	init_effect = {
	}
}

sweep_seeded_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	init_effect = {
		set_global_flag = fixture_map_spawned
		set_star_flag = fixture_claimed
	}
}

sweep_walled_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { fixture_claimed }
	init_effect = {
		create_starbase = {
			size = starbase_hut
		}
	}
}

sweep_scoped_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { fixture_scoped }
}

# Day-one bypasses: the two ends of a wormhole the game-start event links,
# the system it puts a ruined gateway on, a shroud tunnel an initializer
# spawns on its own system, and one whose far end is picked at random.
wormhole_a_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { wh_a }
}

wormhole_b_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { wh_b }
}

gate_flag_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { gate_here }
}

tunnel_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	init_effect = {
		spawn_natural_wormhole = {
			bypass_type = shroud_tunnel
			random_pos = no
			orbit_angle = 360
		}
	}
}

random_gate_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	init_effect = {
		spawn_natural_wormhole = {
			bypass_type = wormhole
			random_pos = no
			orbit_angle = 360
		}
		random_system = {
			limit = { has_natural_wormhole = no }
			spawn_natural_wormhole = {
				bypass_type = wormhole
				random_pos = no
				orbit_angle = 360
			}
			link_wormholes = prev
		}
	}
}

# The vanilla gate shape: the far end is picked first and the own system's
# mouth is spawned back through `prev`, which the `NOR` guard does not name.
chosen_gate_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	init_effect = {
		random_system = {
			limit = {
				has_natural_wormhole = no
				NOR = {
					has_star_flag = wh_a
					has_star_flag = wh_b
				}
			}
			spawn_natural_wormhole = {
				bypass_type = wormhole
				random_pos = no
				orbit_angle = 360
			}
			prev = {
				spawn_natural_wormhole = {
					bypass_type = wormhole
					random_pos = no
					orbit_angle = 270
				}
				link_wormholes = prev
			}
		}
	}
}

# The far end of the day-one pair, on a system that also spawns a tunnel of
# its own: the pairing must not take the tunnel for the wormhole.
tunnel_b_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { wh_b }
	init_effect = {
		spawn_natural_wormhole = {
			bypass_type = shroud_tunnel
			random_pos = no
			orbit_angle = 360
		}
	}
}

prev_wormhole_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { wh_prev }
}

gate_scope_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	flags = { gate_elsewhere }
}

# Two far ends, each spawned in a scope of its own and each linking back
# here: two endpoints, two pairs.
twin_gate_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	init_effect = {
		spawn_natural_wormhole = {
			bypass_type = wormhole
			random_pos = no
			orbit_angle = 90
		}
		spawn_natural_wormhole = {
			bypass_type = wormhole
			random_pos = no
			orbit_angle = 270
		}
		event_target:fixture_far_a = {
			spawn_natural_wormhole = {
				bypass_type = wormhole
				random_pos = no
				orbit_angle = 90
			}
			link_wormholes = prev
		}
		event_target:fixture_far_b = {
			spawn_natural_wormhole = {
				bypass_type = wormhole
				random_pos = no
				orbit_angle = 270
			}
			link_wormholes = prev
		}
	}
}
